steps.name: Environment setup and optional global PATH persistence
steps.description: Verify runtime tools and prepare guarded PATH persistence (opt-in). Ensures python3/pip availability and version, verifies sudo works, ensures sqlite3 CLI is present (installs non-interactively via apt if missing), verifies python's sqlite3 module, and prepares an opt-in /etc/profile.d entry that prepends the project venv bin when CORE_DOCS_PERSIST_VENV_PATH=1. Operates in workspace: /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/wifi-7-functional-test-plan-4457-4631/CoreDocumentation&GovernanceHub
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/wifi-7-functional-test-plan-4457-4631/CoreDocumentation&GovernanceHub"
PROFILE="/etc/profile.d/core_docs_gov.sh"
TMPFILE=$(mktemp)
cleanup(){ rm -f "$TMPFILE" || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT
# Ensure python3 and pip present and get pip version
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: python3 not found" >&2; exit 4; }
if ! python3 -m pip --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ERROR: python3 pip not available" >&2; exit 5
fi
PIP_VER=$(python3 -m pip --version | awk '{print $2}') || true
# Verify sudo exists and is usable
command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: sudo not found; required for optional profile.d writes and package installs" >&2; exit 6; }
if ! sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "ERROR: sudo is present but not usable without password; this script expects NOPASSWD sudo in container" >&2; exit 7
fi
# Ensure sqlite3 CLI; install non-interactively if missing
if ! command -v sqlite3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "sqlite3 CLI missing; attempting non-interactive apt install (sudo)" >&2
  sudo apt-get update -q && sudo apt-get install -y -qq sqlite3 || { echo "ERROR: failed to install sqlite3 via apt" >&2; exit 8; }
fi
# Verify python sqlite3 module
python3 - <<'PY'
import sys
try:
    import sqlite3
except Exception as e:
    sys.stderr.write('ERROR: python sqlite3 module not importable: %s\n'%e)
    sys.exit(9)
PY
# Prepare guarded profile.d content (only created if CORE_DOCS_PERSIST_VENV_PATH=1)
cat > "$TMPFILE" <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Guard: only prepend project venv if it exists and opt-in via env var
if [ "${CORE_DOCS_PERSIST_VENV_PATH:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  VENVPATH="__WORKSPACE__/.venv/bin"
  if [ -d "$VENVPATH" ]; then
    case ":$PATH:" in
      *":$VENVPATH:"*) ;;
      *) export PATH="$VENVPATH:$PATH" ;;
    esac
  fi
fi
EOF
sed -i "s|__WORKSPACE__|${WORKSPACE}|g" "$TMPFILE"
# If opt-in, write atomically using sudo tee and verify
if [ "${CORE_DOCS_PERSIST_VENV_PATH:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  sudo tee "$PROFILE" < "$TMPFILE" >/dev/null && sudo chmod 0755 "$PROFILE" || { echo "ERROR: failed to write $PROFILE" >&2; exit 10; }
fi

steps.name: Install Python dependencies into project venv and validate isolation (robust)
steps.description: Install required Python packages into the workspace venv using the venv's python/pip explicitly from requirements.txt. Upgrade pip in venv, install packages and on failure capture pip logs for debugging. Validate venv isolation by comparing realpath(sys.executable) to realpath(VENV_PY). Operates in workspace: /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/wifi-7-functional-test-plan-4457-4631/CoreDocumentation&GovernanceHub
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/wifi-7-functional-test-plan-4457-4631/CoreDocumentation&GovernanceHub"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
VENV_PY="$WORKSPACE/.venv/bin/python"
[ -x "$VENV_PY" ] || { echo "ERROR: venv python not found: $VENV_PY" >&2; exit 12; }
# upgrade pip (with retries) and capture output on failure
$VENV_PY -m pip --disable-pip-version-check --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
set +e
RETRIES=2; COUNT=0; LAST_ERR=0
while [ $COUNT -le $RETRIES ]; do
  $VENV_PY -m pip --disable-pip-version-check install --no-input --upgrade pip -q && LAST_ERR=0 && break || LAST_ERR=$?
  COUNT=$((COUNT+1)); sleep 1
done
set -e
if [ $LAST_ERR -ne 0 ]; then echo "WARNING: pip upgrade failed (rc=$LAST_ERR), continuing with existing pip" >&2; fi
# Install requirements; on failure capture pip log
set +e
$VENV_PY -m pip --disable-pip-version-check install --no-input -r requirements.txt > "$WORKSPACE/pip_install.log" 2>&1
RC=$?
set -e
if [ $RC -ne 0 ]; then echo "ERROR: pip install failed; tail pip_install.log:" >&2; tail -n 200 "$WORKSPACE/pip_install.log" >&2 || true; exit 13; fi
# Verify isolation using realpath compare
ACTUAL=$($VENV_PY -c 'import sys,os; print(os.path.realpath(sys.executable))')
EXPECT=$(python3 - <<PY
import os
print(os.path.realpath("$VENV_PY"))
PY
)
if [ "$ACTUAL" != "$EXPECT" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: venv isolation check failed: sys.executable=$ACTUAL expected=$EXPECT" >&2
  exit 14
fi
# Print brief evidence
$VENV_PY -c "import flask,pytest,requests,sys; print('executable',sys.executable); print('flask',getattr(flask,'__version__',None)); print('pytest',getattr(pytest,'__version__',None)); print('requests',getattr(requests,'__version__',None))"

steps.name: Setup and run tests (server started in its own process group)
steps.description: Create a pytest that launches the app using the workspace venv python in its own process group (preexec_fn=os.setsid), sets PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 for reliable logs, waits for readiness by attempting HTTP connect (avoids flaky bind checks), performs a request via requests, and ensures clean shutdown by killing the process group. Operates in workspace: /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/wifi-7-functional-test-plan-4457-4631/CoreDocumentation&GovernanceHub
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/wifi-7-functional-test-plan-4457-4631/CoreDocumentation&GovernanceHub"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
VENV_PY="$WORKSPACE/.venv/bin/python"
# create pytest in tests/
cat > "$WORKSPACE/tests/test_basic.py" <<'PY'
import subprocess, os, time, requests, signal, pathlib
import preexec
WORKDIR = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
venv_py = str(WORKDIR / '.venv' / 'bin' / 'python')
# load .env safely
env = os.environ.copy()
envfile = WORKDIR / '.env'
if envfile.exists():
    for line in envfile.read_text().splitlines():
        line = line.split('#',1)[0]
        if not line or '=' not in line: continue
        k,v = line.split('=',1); env[k.strip()] = v.strip()
PORT = int(env.get('APP_PORT','5000'))
# Start server in its own process group
cmd = [venv_py, str(WORKDIR / 'app.py')]
# ensure unbuffered python output
env['PYTHONUNBUFFERED'] = '1'
proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd, env=env, preexec_fn=os.setsid)
try:
    deadline = time.time() + float(env.get('TEST_SERVER_TIMEOUT','10'))
    while time.time() < deadline:
        try:
            r = requests.get(f'http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/', timeout=1.0)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                break
        except Exception:
            time.sleep(0.2)
    else:
        raise RuntimeError('server did not become ready')
    r = requests.get(f'http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/', timeout=5)
    assert r.status_code == 200
finally:
    try:
        pgid = os.getpgid(proc.pid)
        os.killpg(pgid, signal.SIGTERM)
        proc.wait(timeout=3)
    except Exception:
        try:
            proc.kill()
            proc.wait()
        except Exception:
            pass
PY
# run pytest quietly (but keep logs from failures)
"$VENV_PY" -m pytest -q

import subprocess, os, time, requests, signal, pathlib
WORKDIR = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
venv_py = str(WORKDIR / '.venv' / 'bin' / 'python')
# load .env safely
env = os.environ.copy()
envfile = WORKDIR / '.env'
if envfile.exists():
    for line in envfile.read_text().splitlines():
        line = line.split('#',1)[0]
        if not line or '=' not in line: continue
        k,v = line.split('=',1); env[k.strip()] = v.strip()
PORT = int(env.get('APP_PORT','5000'))
# Start server in its own process group
cmd = [venv_py, str(WORKDIR / 'app.py')]
# ensure unbuffered python output
env['PYTHONUNBUFFERED'] = '1'
proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd, env=env, preexec_fn=os.setsid)
try:
    deadline = time.time() + float(env.get('TEST_SERVER_TIMEOUT','10'))
    while time.time() < deadline:
        try:
            r = requests.get(f'http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/', timeout=1.0)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                break
        except Exception:
            time.sleep(0.2)
    else:
        raise RuntimeError('server did not become ready')
    r = requests.get(f'http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/', timeout=5)
    assert r.status_code == 200
finally:
    try:
        pgid = os.getpgid(proc.pid)
        os.killpg(pgid, signal.SIGTERM)
        proc.wait(timeout=3)
    except Exception:
        try:
            proc.kill()
            proc.wait()
        except Exception:
            pass
PY

# Run pytest using venv python; if venv python missing, exit with clear message
if [ ! -x "$VENV_PY" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: venv python not found at $VENV_PY. Create the venv and install requirements before running tests." >&2
  exit 2
fi
"$VENV_PY" -m pytest -q

Falls back to killing APP_PID if PGID detection fails. Operates in workspace: /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/wifi-7-functional-test-plan-4457-4631/CoreDocumentation&GovernanceHub and depends on all prior steps.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/wifi-7-functional-test-plan-4457-4631/CoreDocumentation&GovernanceHub"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
VENV_PY="$WORKSPACE/.venv/bin/python"
[ -x "$VENV_PY" ] || { echo "ERROR: VENV_PY not found: $VENV_PY" >&2; exit 3; }
# load env safely and extract APP_PORT robustly
ENVFILE="$WORKSPACE/.env"
APP_PORT=5000
if [ -f "$ENVFILE" ]; then
  APP_PORT=$(awk -F= '/^APP_PORT=/{gsub(/\r/,"",$2); gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/,"",$2); print $2}' "$ENVFILE" | head -n1 || true)
  APP_PORT=${APP_PORT:-5000}
fi
# Start server in new process group using setsid, capture PID and PGID
LOG="$WORKSPACE/server.log"
setsid "$VENV_PY" "$WORKSPACE/app.py" > "$LOG" 2>&1 &
APP_PID=$!
# get PGID robustly
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p ${APP_PID} 2>/dev/null || true)
PGID=$(echo "$PGID" | tr -d ' ')
if ! [[ "$PGID" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  PGID=""
fi
# wait-for-port loop
START=0; TIMEOUT=${VALIDATION_TIMEOUT:-10}
while [ $START -lt $TIMEOUT ]; do
  if curl -sS --max-time 1 http://127.0.0.1:${APP_PORT}/ >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
  START=$((START+1)); sleep 1
done
if ! curl -sS --max-time 1 http://127.0.0.1:${APP_PORT}/ >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "VALIDATION_FAILED: server did not start within ${TIMEOUT}s" >&2
  tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2 || true
  if [ -n "$PGID" ]; then
    kill -TERM -"$PGID" 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; kill -9 -"$PGID" 2>/dev/null || true
  else
    kill ${APP_PID} 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; kill -9 ${APP_PID} 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  exit 2
fi
# Capture body and status
BODY_FILE="$WORKSPACE/validation_body.tmp"
HTTP_STATUS=$(curl -sS -w "%{http_code}" -o "$BODY_FILE" http://127.0.0.1:${APP_PORT}/ || true)
BODY_PREVIEW=$(head -c 200 "$BODY_FILE" | tr -d '\n' || true)
# Stop server group robustly
if [ -n "$PGID" ]; then
  kill -TERM -"$PGID" 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1 || true; if ps -o pgid= -p ${APP_PID} >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill -9 -"$PGID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
else
  kill ${APP_PID} 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1 || true; if ps -p ${APP_PID} >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill -9 ${APP_PID} 2>/dev/null || true; fi
fi
# Output concise evidence
if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" = "200" ]; then
  echo "VALIDATION_OK: status=${HTTP_STATUS} body_preview=${BODY_PREVIEW}"
  rm -f "$BODY_FILE"
  exit 0
else
  echo "VALIDATION_FAILED: status=${HTTP_STATUS} body_preview=${BODY_PREVIEW}" >&2
  tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2 || true
  rm -f "$BODY_FILE"
  exit 2
fi
